whenToUse: A news site, daily paper or multi-section magazine with a dense front page: lead grid, section modules, ticker, ads and a sidebar.
Publishers that need section fronts, numbered archives, reader sign-in and consent-aware ad slots.
avoidWhen: A single-voice essay magazine or quarterly — use site-blog-01.
a11y: One h1 per page; every module is a section named by its heading and every story an article with one covering link.
The ticker pauses on hover, focus and its button and never autoplays under reduced motion; mega menus open on focus as well as hover.
